title: Lecturer on Oral Health Policy and Epidemiology, Part-time
bio: Dr. David Okuji trained at the UCLA School of Dentistry, the University of Southern California, U.C. Berkeley-Haas School of Business, and the Harvard School of Public Health. He currently serves in the roles of Senior Associate Director at NYU Langone Hospitals and Lecturer in Oral Health Policy and Epidemiology, part-time, at HSDM. He is also board certified in pediatric dentistry and public health, and his primary academic interests are in pediatric dentistry, value-based health care systems, implementation science, and global public health.
